title: Gift Swipe Big Idea Deck
project: Gift Swipe (public gift app): creative idea from taste, not exact gifts
example_data: All app screens are rendered HTML mockups with made-up SAMPLE data (recipient "Robin", .example stores).

pairs.ask: What do people swipe, if not exact gifts?

optionA.label: Taste cards
optionA.desc: Moods, places and little things: "slow mornings", "a cabin in rain", "old maps".
optionA.more: Swipes learn what the person likes. The gift comes after, from Swatch reading the picks.

optionB.label: Gift-shaped hints
optionB.desc: Kinds of gifts, never products: "something to make", "a day out".
optionB.more: Closer to a gift but still open. Swatch turns the winner into one creative idea.

pairs.ask: What comes out at the end?

optionA.label: One idea, with the why
optionA.desc: One gift they would never have thought of, and three lines on why it fits.
optionA.more: Feels like a friend who really listened. Easy to share.

optionB.label: Three ideas plus a wildcard
optionB.desc: Three good fits and one left-field surprise.
optionB.more: More choice, still creative. The wildcard is where Machan has fun.

optionA.label: Type bar under every card
optionA.desc: A small "say more" line always there. Swipe, or type, or both.
optionA.more: Swipe and Type in one move. Anything typed is read with the swipes.

optionB.label: Type at round breaks
optionB.desc: Swipe clean, then a "tell me more" moment between rounds.
optionB.more: Cleaner cards. Typing gets its own calm spot.

pairs.ask: Where do the on/off switches go?

optionA.label: Gear behind the cover
optionA.desc: One settings sheet: budget mode, live taste meter, typing, sound.
optionA.more: Out of the way for first-timers, easy to find.

optionB.label: Toggles on the cover
optionB.desc: Three small switches right under Start.
optionB.more: People see the options up front. A little busier.

pairs.ask: Budget mode out of the box?

optionA.label: Soft: around
optionA.desc: "Around $75". Ideas a little over get a small tag.
optionA.more: More creative room. Switchable in Settings.

optionB.label: Hard cap: up to
optionB.more: Safest for tight budgets. Switchable in Settings.

pairs.ask: Which lore line sits under the name?

optionA.label: "Read the seed. Find the gift."
optionA.desc: Machan's second catchphrase, bent to gifts.
optionA.more: Says the app reads the person first.

optionB.label: "May all your gifts go as you wish."
optionB.desc: Machan's main wish, bent to gifts.
optionB.more: Warm, a blessing more than a promise.

pairs.ask: In the gift app, Machan says…

optionA.label: A line per round
optionA.desc: Few words, sly, one per round. Mystery stays.
optionA.more: Matches his X voice: mystery, playful when it counts.

optionB.label: Guide on every card
optionB.desc: A small comment on each pair.
optionB.more: Friendlier, but more words on screen.

pairs.ask: How do people see more about an idea?

optionA.label: Tap the tile for more
optionA.desc: Clean tile, tap to open the why, the price range and where to look.
optionA.more: Your "click for more info" habit, built in.

optionB.label: All on the card
optionB.desc: Why, price range and tips shown at once.

pairs.ask: How do we point people to the gift?

optionA.label: Ideas only
optionA.desc: No links at all. The idea is the gift from us.
optionA.more: Purest "we are giving our ideas for free".

optionB.label: Idea plus "where to look"
optionB.desc: A plain search link, no shop, no affiliate.
optionB.more: Helps people act on it without us selling anything.

optionA.label: Season-aware
optionA.desc: Loy Krathong, Christmas, New Year, birthdays: ideas bend to the time of year.

optionB.label: Timeless
optionB.desc: Same ideas any day of the year.
optionB.more: Simpler; the person matters more than the date.

pairs.ask: What do we call the final idea?

optionA.label: The Seed
optionA.desc: "Your seed is ready." Ties to read the seed.

optionB.label: Machan's Pick
optionB.desc: "Machan's pick for Robin." Plain and warm.
optionB.more: Clear to everyone, puts Machan in the moment.
